vocabulary.definition: likely or liable to be influenced or harmed by a particular thing
vocabulary.example: Children are more susceptible to colds than adults.

vocabulary.definition: the state of relying on or being controlled by something or someone else
vocabulary.example: His dependence on caffeine became evident when he couldn't function without his morning coffee.

vocabulary.definition: a state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced
vocabulary.example: The therapist helped her find an equilibrium between work and personal life.

vocabulary.definition: to succeed in forcing a way into or through something
vocabulary.example: The arrow failed to penetrate the armor, leaving the knight unharmed.

vocabulary.definition: having the ability to withstand the effects of something
vocabulary.example: Some bacteria have become resistant to antibiotics due to overuse.

vocabulary.definition: the process of removing toxic substances from the body
vocabulary.example: After years of heavy drinking, he decided to undergo a detoxing program to cleanse his body.
